segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the final order details for the 82 seats and make sure we're still tracking to a March 18 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that date still works. Finance approved the $48,600 annual, paid quarterly, as long as the first invoice lands after March 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The billing tool is set for a March 4 invoice date, net 30. The services line is still the one-time $6,200 for onboarding and admin training.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. One thing, though. The kickoff note I got this morning says our workspace is being set up in the US region. We had EU region in the redline, because our support team in Dublin is the first group going live.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Ah, yeah, I see what you're saying. Let me get that corrected before they send login links. It may move the sandbox access from Friday to Monday, but it shouldn't change March 18.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Monday is fine. I just don't want to explain to legal why the first email says something different than the contract.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fair. I'll send you a clean kickoff note by end of day with EU region, 82 seats, and the March 4 invoice timing called out.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Once I have that, I'll countersign and send the procurement PO number over.
